router.help:
Just type to talk to the AI.

**When Bridge asks you**
- `!ok` / `!no` yes / no (a permission request needs its code: `!ok 1234`)
- `!a 1234 answer` answer the AI's question
- `!1`, `!2`… pick from a menu, `!next` next page

**Control**
- `!stop` stop everything (current work, queued messages, your schedules)
- `!go` continue paused work (`!go new` sends only the newer messages, dropping ones from an hour or more ago)
- `!status` current state and queued messages
- `!pending` things waiting for your reply

**Conversation**
- `!new` new conversation, `!disconnect` disconnect this topic
- `!model` change model, `!agent` change Agent
- `!rename title`, `!fork` branch off, `!compact` compact
- `!undo` roll back to before a message, `!redo` bring it back, `!discard` delete for good

**Read**
- `!history` earlier messages, `!output` the latest reply in full
- `!files` find files, `!file path` download, `!diff` what changed

**More**
- Schedules: just say “every 30 minutes … until 18:00”; `!schedule` lists them
- Git: `!commit message`, `!push`
- `!send text` sends text exactly as written (even if it starts with `!`)
- `!lang en` / `!lang zh-TW` interface language

Advanced commands: `!help all`

form.step_help:
Answer: `!a {token} <answer>`

Text: -- <text>; choices: 1 or 1,3; custom: -- <text> or 1,3 -- <text>; yes/no; external action done: ack

Skip optional: `!a {token} /skip`

Change page: `!a {token} /page <number>`

Nothing is sent until the final submit. To change an answer use edit in the review; editing chat messages does not change the draft.
form.review_help:
Submit: `!a {token} submit`

Change a field: `!a {token} edit <number>`

Skipped optional fields are left out. If this code expires, continue with `!pending`.

console.read_only: Metadata view. Changes and upstream probes are not available on this page.
console.not_probed: No connection probe was run. Enrollment verification does not certify full compatibility.
console.restart: These are loaded settings. Edit the private server configuration and restart the Bridge to apply static changes.
console.managed: Managed mode. Current consumer health is reported by the readiness endpoint.
console.source_bridge_database: Source: Bridge-owned database metadata. Prompts, outputs and interaction bodies are excluded.
console.source_loaded_configuration: Source: loaded configuration; original per-field source precedence is not yet reported.
console.source_operator_guidance: Operator guidance; this view does not create or download a backup.
console.live_pages: Pages use an exclusive ID cursor over live data; concurrent inserts with earlier IDs can appear after a refresh. Start again to refresh.
console.backup_consistent: Use the operator backup command for a consistent Bridge-owned database snapshot; never copy the running database file alone.
console.backup_encrypted: Back up encrypted artifact files together with required keys using separate restricted storage. Keep pending and ambiguous work.
console.backup_restore: Validate restore offline before a controlled switchover. Never overwrite newer production data or the original Agent database.
console.backup_private: Export only reviewed metadata for sharing. Operational endpoints, accounts, credentials and connection SOPs stay private.
console.binding_controls: Preview and confirm local queue pause or unbind. Other administrative changes are not yet available.
console.control_error: Unable to complete this request. State may have changed; cancel and refresh before a new preview. If a confirmation response was lost, retry the same confirmation.
console.control_auth: Administrator login expired or was revoked. Sign in again and create a new preview.
console.pause_warning: This pauses queued dispatch and holds unsent queued actions. Work already running in the original Agent continues. It does not cancel that work or answer any permission request.
console.unbind_warning: This disconnects this Bridge binding and pauses unsent work. The original Agent session, pending interactions and journals are retained. Automatic delivery may stop; this does not delete or cancel the original session.
console.control_confirmed: The local administrative operation is recorded. The original Agent session has not been deleted. Close to refresh the metadata.
console.control_cancelled: This preview was cancelled; no binding or queue change was applied. Close to refresh.
console.refused_backends: Backend enrollment and connection probes are not available from the web. Enrollment comes from the operator-reviewed runtime manifest; use the operator procedure and restart.
console.refused_compatibility: Compatibility certification is not changed from the web. Enrollment verification is shown; full certification requires separate operator evidence.
console.refused_bindings: New bindings and queue resume need an authorized Zulip Human in the bound topic. This page can only preview pause or unbind.
console.refused_actions: Web administrators cannot create Agent actions. Actions come only from authorized Zulip Humans.
console.refused_interactions: Permission and question replies are answered by authorized Zulip Humans in the bound topic, not from the web.
console.refused_grants: Role grants come from the operator-reviewed runtime manifest. Web changes are refused so the reviewed evidence stays authoritative.
console.confirm_expiry: A preview expires after five minutes. A change to the scope, queue, pending work, login or Bridge process requires a new preview.
console.scroll_review: Scroll inside this dialog to review the full scope. These are recorded binding members; this local operation does not probe current Zulip membership.
console.settings_note: Reviewed non-secret settings. Site language and live draft update interval support confirmed runtime changes; other displayed fields require a restart. Personal/topic language preferences remain separate. Unknown/changed startup sources remain unconfirmed.
console.source_startup_configuration: Source: effective Bridge settings. The source and application mode are shown per value.
console.site_locale_scope: Changes the default for administrator pages and sign-in. Saved personal preferences take priority; Bot personal and shared-topic language settings remain separate. No Agent request is sent.
console.environment_priority: An explicit environment override remains effective when a runtime override is saved or removed. Environment changes require restart; afterward the saved runtime choice or TOML/default applies.
console.setting_saved: Setting saved. Refresh to read the current effective value. This receipt records this operation; later changes may differ.
console.setting_controls: Startup fields are read-only. Site language and live draft update interval support scoped previews and confirmations.
console.draft_interval_scope: Applies to future planning of new and existing live draft messages across enrolled sessions. Values are milliseconds (1–60000). The shared Bot/realm limiter still applies. A deferred draft is reconsidered at its recorded retry time; a change does not rewrite or resend pending requests. Final replies and permission/question notifications keep their own delivery paths.

router.paused_gap: This topic is paused because OpenCode restarted and the conversation must be reconnected, so this message waits. Reply `!ok` to reconnect; it is then sent in order. `!no` drops it.
router.paused_gap_stopped: This topic is paused: you stopped it earlier and OpenCode has restarted, so this message waits. Reply `!ok` to reconnect, then `!go` (it sends this too); `!no` drops it.
router.restart_waiting: Bridge restarted. Some messages waiting here are older than 10 minutes or were held for another reason, so none were sent automatically. `!go` sends them in order; `!no` drops them.
router.restart_missed: Some messages sent here while Bridge was offline were not sent to OpenCode. Send them again if you still need them.
router.gap_go: Can't continue yet: OpenCode restarted, so this conversation must be reconnected first. Reply `!ok` to reconnect.
worktree.offer: Create a separate worktree for new work: `!oz worktree create {token}`. The current conversation is not moved.
worktree.completed: Worktree created: {directory}. The current conversation was not moved; the new workspace needs its own setup. Receipt: {receipt}.
worktree.not_sent: The create request was not sent. Preview again before retrying. Receipt: {receipt}.
worktree.unknown: Not sure whether the worktree was created. Don't create it again. Check: `!oz worktree status {receipt}`
worktree.cancelled: Cancelled; the create request was not sent. Receipt: {receipt}.
worktree.switch.preview:
Switch this topic to conversation {session} in {directory}?
Future messages go there. Messages still queued for the old conversation won't run; work already started isn't interrupted, but this topic stops showing it. No conversation or directory is moved.
Confirm within 60 seconds: !oz worktree switch {token}

Workspace has changes: {dirty}. Shared workspaces can conflict, and outside edits can't be locked out.
worktree.switch.done: This topic now uses conversation {session} in {directory}. Earlier work isn't interrupted.
action.attachments_off: This topic can't take file uploads yet, so this message wasn't sent. Please send it again as text.
action.not_sent: This message wasn't sent to OpenCode and hasn't started. Ask an administrator to check the backend connection and settings, then send it again. It won't be retried automatically.
action.source_changed: That message wasn't sent: the original was changed or could not be confirmed. Please send it again.
action.not_sent_unavailable: That message wasn't sent: OpenCode could not be reached for several minutes. Please send it again once it is back.
action.not_sent_unconfirmed: That message wasn't sent: for several minutes OpenCode could not confirm the state of this conversation. Nothing was changed; please send it again (`!status` shows the current state).
action.not_sent_never_arrived: An earlier message never reached OpenCode, so it got no reply and will not be resent automatically. Send it again if you still need it; later messages go out in order.
action.not_sent_session_unavailable: That message wasn't sent: this conversation could not be reached in OpenCode for several minutes. The Bridge keeps trying to reconnect it; please send it again once it is back.
action.not_sent_schedule_off: This scheduled message wasn't sent: scheduled sends are off right now. Ask an administrator to turn them back on; you can type this one yourself.
generated.capability_disabled: Automatic file capture is off. Existing capture jobs still need handling.
generated.capability_not_enrolled: Automatic file capture isn't set up for this conversation.
generated.capability_enabled: Automatic file capture is on for this conversation.
git_evidence.title: Historical Git check · {action}
git_evidence.scope: Past result only; current files and remote may differ.
git_evidence.head: HEAD: {value}
git_evidence.empty: No staged paths in this result. Working files were not checked.
git_evidence.unavailable: Git history isn't available for this conversation yet. No check was run.
git_evidence.help: Git: `!commit message`, `!push`, `!git context`, `!git review`, `!git patch <path>`. Project checks: `!checks`. After one finishes, `!git evidence <action-id>` shows its Git result if enabled.
reconnect.completed: Reconnected; some live details may not show. This topic still has paused or possibly unfinished work, so it does not continue yet: check `!status`, then reply `!go` to continue.
reconnect.resumed: Reconnected to this conversation; you can keep typing. Some live progress may have been missed.
reconnect.automatic: OpenCode restarted; this conversation was reconnected automatically.
reconnect.automatic_paused: OpenCode restarted; this conversation was reconnected automatically. The topic is still paused: check `!status`, then reply `!go` to continue.
reconnect.automatic_refused: OpenCode restarted, and its program, settings or plugins also changed, so for safety it needs your OK once. Reply `!ok` to reconnect (`!reconnect` shows the details first, if you like); messages sent meanwhile then go in order.
reconnect.capacity: This connection has reached its recovery limit. The conversation and queue are intact. An administrator must review and archive recovery history before reconnecting.
filemenu.turns: Choose a turn. `!diff` shows the default turn.
filemenu.selected_turn: Turn: {turn} (conversation changes, not a Git diff)
filemenu.default_turn: Default turn. Choose another with `!diff turns`.
discovery.go_plain: This topic isn't connected yet, and your message wasn't sent. Choose one:
discovery.choose_go: Reply `!1`, `!2`, … to connect. Find one by name: `!go keyword`.
discovery.go_none: No conversations available. Send `!go` to see them all.
discovery.go_new: **Start a brand-new conversation in project {project}** (does not continue an existing one)
discovery.prompt_sent: Your earlier message was sent too.
discovery.prompt_failed: Your earlier message was not sent; please send it again.
discovery.go_elsewhere: Already connected in another topic: {titles}. Continue there.
discovery.connected: Connected to **{title}** ({project}). Just type here to send to it. Wrong one? Open a new topic and choose again.
discovery.go_buttons: Click to connect. Find one by name: !go keyword
agents.unavailable: Agent switching isn't enabled for this session. `!agents` shows the list.
agents.none_enabled: No other Agent is approved for this session.
agents.busy: The session is busy. You can switch when it is idle.
agents.first_message: Send one message and wait for its reply before switching.
agents.permissions_differ: Their permissions differ, so tools and instructions may change.
agents.effect: Steps already running may keep the old Agent. New steps read the new setting.
agents.applied: Default Agent is now **{after}**. Steps already running may keep the old Agent; new steps read this setting.
agents.queue_held: {count} waiting message(s) were held. Check `!status`, then reply `!go`.
agents.not_sent: The switch was not sent. Agent is still **{current}**.
agents.uncertain: Couldn't confirm the switch. It won't be sent again. Use `!agent` to review.
agents.in_progress: A switch is in progress. Try again shortly.
agents.unknown_result: The last switch has an unknown result. OpenCode reports **{current}**.
agents.external_change: The Agent was changed outside Zulip. OpenCode reports **{current}**.
agents.not_approved: That Agent isn't approved here, so this topic is read-only. Ask the administrator.
agents.adopt_prompt: Reply `!ok` within 2 minutes to continue with **{current}**. Nothing is sent to OpenCode.
agents.adopted: Continuing with **{current}**. Nothing was sent to OpenCode.
agents.changed_before_enrollment: This session's Agent or permissions no longer match its enrollment. Ask the administrator.
agents.input_waiting: An Agent switch is in progress. Your message hasn't started and will be held. See `!status`.
agents.input_review: This session needs an Agent review before it can run. Your message hasn't started. Use `!agent`.
menu.no_open: There is no menu to pick from by number. Open one again (for example `!model`, `!history` or `!pending`), then reply `!number`.
git_publish.unavailable: Git commit and push aren't available for this conversation. Nothing was read or sent.
git_publish.no_force: Force push is never offered from chat. Nothing was read or sent.
git_publish.bad_name: Use a plain remote and branch name (no `+`, `:` or options). Nothing was read or sent.
git_publish.bad_message: Use a one-line commit message of up to 500 characters. Nothing was read or sent.
git_publish.no_options: Only file paths can follow the message, no options. Nothing was read or sent.
git_publish.too_many: Name at most {limit} files. Nothing was read or sent.
git_publish.outside_root: {path} isn't a path inside this project. Nothing was sent.
git_publish.protected_path: {path} is a protected file (keys, credentials, `.env`, `.git` and similar). It can't be committed from chat. Nothing was sent.
git_publish.paused: This topic is paused. Reply `!go` before committing or pushing. Nothing was sent.
git_publish.busy: OpenCode is still working in this conversation. Try again when it's idle. Nothing was sent.
git_publish.detached: This project isn't on a branch (detached HEAD), so nothing can be committed or pushed from chat.
git_publish.conflicts: {count} changed file(s) still contain merge conflict markers. Resolve them first. Nothing was sent.
git_publish.nothing: There are no changes to commit.
git_publish.nothing_hidden: There are no changes you can commit from chat. {count} protected file(s) changed; those stay out of chat.
git_publish.not_changed: {path} has no uncommitted change, so it can't be committed. Nothing was sent.
git_publish.other_branch: Only the current branch, {branch}, can be pushed from chat. Nothing was sent.
git_publish.no_upstream: There's no {remote}/{branch} here. To create it, name it: `!push {remote} {branch}`. Nothing was sent.
git_publish.nothing_to_push: {ref} already has everything on this branch. Nothing to push.
git_publish.secret_like: The command would contain something that looks like a secret, so it isn't offered. Nothing was sent.
git_publish.left_out: Not included: {count} other changed file(s) and {hidden} protected file(s).
git_publish.new_remote_branch: {ref} doesn't exist yet; the push would create it. Its contents can't be compared beforehand.
git_publish.fast_forward_unknown: Whether this is a fast-forward can't be read from OpenCode 2.0.32. Force is never sent, so Git itself refuses a push that would overwrite remote work.
git_publish.command: The bridge will ask OpenCode's agent to run exactly this, and nothing else:
git_publish.agent_rules: The agent's own permission rules apply: a shell permission request comes to you as usual, and a conversation that may not run commands can't do this. Afterwards the bridge reads Git again and reports only what it can see.
git_publish.too_long: This preview is too long for one message. Name fewer files. Nothing was sent.
git_publish.changed: Something changed since that preview (files, branch or remote ref), so that confirmation no longer applies and nothing was sent.
git_publish.already_confirmed: That confirmation was already used. It is sent once only; the result will be posted here.
git_publish.sending: Confirmed. Asking OpenCode once. The result will be checked and posted here.
git_publish.expired: That Git confirmation wasn't sent in time, so nothing was sent. Preview again if you still want it.
git_publish.refused: That Git request wasn't sent: the preview, its confirmation or this conversation changed. Preview again if you still want it.
git_publish.unknown_result: Couldn't tell whether the {kind} request reached OpenCode. It won't be sent again. Check `!git review` before doing anything else.
git_publish.result_not_done.commit: **Not committed.** Nothing changed in Git. The turn {turn}.
git_publish.result_not_done.push: **Not pushed.** Nothing changed in Git. The turn {turn}.
git_publish.result_not_verified.commit: **Commit not verified.** Git changed, but not exactly as previewed:
git_publish.result_not_verified.push: **Push not verified.** Git changed, but not exactly as expected:
git_publish.turn.succeeded: finished (the agent may not be allowed to run commands; see its reply)
git_publish.turn.interrupted: stopped (for example, the shell permission was declined)
git_publish.check.other_changes_kept.pas: other uncommitted changes are as they were
git_publish.check.files_no_longer_change: {count} previewed file(s) no longer differ from HEAD
only {count} previewed file(s) no longer differ from HEAD
HEAD now has the previewed changes (compared with {comparison})
HEAD doesn't show the previewed changes (compared with {comparison})
git_publish.check.head_unseen.fail: whether HEAD moved can't be seen: there is no remote or base branch to compare with, so the files may also have been discarded
git_publish.check.head_other_files_uncha: no other file changed in HEAD
other files also changed in HEAD
git_publish.check.working_copy_unchanged: the working copy is as it was
git_publish.check.tracking_has_head.pass: {ref} now has the same content as HEAD (the local remote-tracking ref)
git_publish.check.tracking_has_head.fail: {ref} doesn't have the same content as HEAD
git_publish.unverifiable: Not visible to the bridge with OpenCode 2.0.32: {items}.
schedule.proposal:
⏰ Set this up as a schedule?

- Every {every}, send: “{task}”
- From now until {end}, about {count} times

Reply `!ok` to start; the first one goes right away. To ask once exactly as written, reply `!send`. `!no` drops it; with no reply, this message is not sent to OpenCode and the offer ends in 10 minutes.
schedule.set:
Schedule set: every {every}, “{task}”, until {end}, {count} times. The first one goes right away.

See it: `!schedule` · Stop it: `!stop`
schedule.already: This message already has a schedule. See it with `!schedule`.
schedule.edited: The schedule from this message has stopped.
schedule.edited_plain: The schedule from this message has stopped. The edited message is not sent to OpenCode; send a new message to ask.
schedule.paused: This topic is paused. Reply `!go` first, then send the schedule again.
schedule.nothing_open: No schedule is waiting for confirmation here.
schedule.once: Sent once as written; no schedule was set.
schedule.none: This topic has no running schedule.
schedule.none_to_stop: There is no schedule of yours to stop here.
schedule.cancelled.source_changed: Schedule stopped: its original message was edited or deleted.
schedule.cancelled.authorization_revoked: Schedule stopped: the person who set it can no longer operate this topic.
schedule.cancelled.binding_changed: Schedule stopped: this topic is no longer connected to that session.
schedule.empty: That reads like a schedule, but there is nothing to do besides the time. Say both, for example “every 30 minutes check my mail until 18:00”.
schedule.too_often: A schedule can run at most every {minutes} minutes.
schedule.too_rare: A schedule can wait at most {hours} hours between sends.
schedule.too_far: The end time must be within {hours} hours.
schedule.too_many: A schedule can send at most {limit} times. Use a longer interval or an earlier end time.
schedule.ended: That end time has already passed. Send the schedule again.
schedule.help: Write it in plain words, for example “every 30 minutes check my mail until 18:00”. The bridge shows what it understood; `!ok` starts it. `!schedule` lists this topic's schedules and `!stop` stops them.
router.nothing_to_decline: Nothing is waiting for your answer.
router.nothing_to_confirm: Nothing is waiting for your confirmation; it may have expired or is no longer valid. `!status` shows what is going on.
router.bare_answer_ok:
Are you answering the question above? Reply `!ok` to confirm or `!no` to decline.

router.bare_answer_no:
Are you declining the question above? Reply `!no` to decline or `!ok` to confirm.
"{word}" was not sent to the AI; to say it to the AI, reply `!send {word}`.
router.bare_answer_question: OpenCode is asking you a question, so "{word}" was not sent. `!pending` shows the question and how to answer it; to say it to the AI, reply `!send {word}`.
router.bare_answer_permission:
Are you answering the permission request above (code {code})? Reply `!ok {code}` to allow it once or `!no {code}` to refuse.
"{word}" was not sent to the AI; to say it to the AI, reply `!send {word}`.
router.bare_answer_several: Several requests are waiting for your reply, so "{word}" was not sent. `!pending` shows each one with its code; to say it to the AI, reply `!send {word}`.
router.status_permission: A permission request waits for you: reply `!ok {code}` to allow it once or `!no {code}` to refuse; `!pending` shows what it asks.
router.status_pending: Something waits for your reply; `!pending` shows each item and how to answer it.
router.held_hint: Messages not sent yet: `!go` sends them, `!no` drops them.
router.held_hint_old: Messages not sent yet, some from an hour or more ago: `!go new` sends only the newer ones and drops your old ones, `!go` sends all, `!no` drops all.
router.dropped_held: Dropped {count} unsent message(s); none reached the AI.
router.typo: There is no `{typed}` command; did you mean `{meant}`? This was not sent to the AI. To send it as written, put `!send ` in front.
